claims.claim: Rule 7100 sets trading and settlement practices to promote fair and efficient debt markets
claims.quote: Rule 7100 establishes trading and settlement practices to promote fair and efficient debt securities markets.

claims.claim: Rule 7100 applies to institutional and retail markets alike unless stated otherwise
claims.quote: Unless expressly indicated, Rule 7100 makes no distinction between institutional and retail markets.

claims.claim: Dealer must ensure debt trading does not breach laws/directions incl. Bank of Canada and Dept of Finance, binding or not
claims.quote: must ensure that its trading in the debt securities markets does not contravene any applicable laws, regulation, direction, or requirement, whether or not such requirement is binding or has the force of law, including without limitation the directions or requirements of the Bank of Canada or the Department of Finance (Canada).

claims.claim: Dealer must not condone or knowingly facilitate breaches by affiliates, clients or counterparties
claims.quote: must not condone or knowingly facilitate conduct by its affiliates , clients, or counterparties that contravenes Rule 7100.

claims.claim: P&P must specifically address debt-market trading and conduct to give reasonable assurance of compliance
claims.quote: policies and procedures must specifically address trading and conduct in the debt securities market to provide reasonable assurance of compliance with securities laws and Corporation requirements

claims.claim: P&P must address restrictions/controls on non-client account trading
claims.quote: restrictions of, and controls over, trading in non- client accounts

claims.claim: P&P must prohibit use of inside information
claims.quote: a prohibition on the use of inside information,

claims.claim: P&P must prohibit front-running and set standards for fair allocation of new issues
claims.quote: a prohibition of front-running, (iv) standards for fair allocation of new issues among clients

claims.claim: P&P must set standards for prompt and accurate conflict disclosure
claims.quote: standards for prompt and accurate disclosure to clients and counterparties if any conflict of interest arises

claims.claim: Retail: written mark-up/mark-down/commission guidelines for Registered Representatives
claims.quote: written policies or guidelines issued to its Registered Representatives on the Dealer Member's mark-ups, mark-downs and commissions on debt securities sold to clients or purchased from clients

claims.claim: Retail: monitoring to detect mark-ups/mark-downs/commissions exceeding the firm's maximums
claims.quote: reasonable monitoring procedures to detect mark-ups, mark-downs or commissions that exceed the maximums specified by the Dealer Member , and to ensure any deviation is justified.

claims.claim: P&P must address restricting confidential information to personnel who need it, confining trading by designated personnel to restricted-access office areas, and secure communications
claims.quote: restricting access to confidential information to the personnel that require it for their jobs, (ii) confining trading by designated personnel to restricted-access office areas, and (iii) using secure forms of communications and technology.

claims.claim: An Executive of the business group must approve the P&P
claims.quote: An Executive responsible for the appropriate business group of the Dealer Member must approve the policies, procedures and internal controls

claims.claim: P&P reviewed regularly for size, nature and complexity of the business
claims.quote: must regularly review its policies and procedures to ensure they are appropriate for the size, nature, and complexity of the Dealer Member's business.

claims.claim: Debt trading personnel must be properly qualified and trained
claims.quote: must ensure that all personnel trading in the debt securities markets are: (i) properly qualified and trained

claims.claim: Trading activities must be supervised by a Supervisor
claims.quote: A Supervisor in the appropriate business group of the Dealer Member must supervise its trading activities.

claims.claim: Duties to clients come before the dealer's or its personnel's interests
claims.quote: A Dealer Member must fulfill its duties to clients before its own interests or those of its personnel.

claims.claim: Dealer must monitor employees' and agents' debt-market trading and conduct
claims.quote: A Dealer Member must monitor the trading and conduct of its employees and agents in the debt securities markets.

claims.claim: Prompt reporting of breaches or suspicious/irregular conduct to CIRO or other authority incl. Bank of Canada
claims.quote: must promptly report to the Corporation or other authority having jurisdiction, including the Bank of Canada: (i) any breaches of Corporation requirements, or (ii) suspicious or irregular market conduct.

claims.claim: Dealer must not engage in manipulative or deceptive practices in debt trading
claims.quote: must not, directly or indirectly, engage or participate in any act, method or practice it knows or ought reasonably to know is manipulative or deceptive.

claims.claim: Examples: trades to artificially increase volumes or change prices
claims.quote: carrying out trades intended to artificially increase trading volumes, (ii) carrying out trades intended to artificially change trading prices

claims.claim: Examples: spreading false rumours
claims.quote: participating in or tacitly consenting to spreading rumours or information about issuers that are known, or ought reasonably to be known, to be false or misleading

claims.claim: Examples: collusion
claims.quote: conspiring or colluding with another market participant to manipulate or unfairly deal in the debt securities markets.

claims.claim: Unfair advantage: proprietary trades ahead of same-side client orders without disclosure and client approval
claims.quote: carrying out proprietary trades ahead of client orders on the same side of the market without first disclosing to the client the intention to do so and obtaining the client's approval

claims.claim: Dealer must not accept an order or trade it knows/has reasonable grounds to believe breaches requirements or law
claims.quote: must not accept any order or carry out any trade where the Dealer Member knows, or has reasonable grounds to believe, the result would contravene Corporation requirements or any applicable laws

claims.claim: Key rule: Approved Person/employee must not accept outside material consideration for client activities
claims.quote: An Approved Person or employee of a Dealer Member must not accept any material consideration, including remuneration, gratuity or benefit, from any person other than the Dealer Member for any activities conducted on behalf of a client.

claims.claim: Dealer must not offer consideration to any partner, director, officer, employee, agent or shareholder of a client, or their associates, without the client's prior written consent
claims.quote: must not offer any consideration, including remuneration, gratuity, or benefit, to any partner, director, officer, employee, agent or shareholder of a client or any associate of such persons, unless the prior written consent of the client has been obtained.

claims.claim: Minimal-value, infrequent, non-monetary items are not consideration under both 7112(2) (accepting) and 7112(3) (offering)
claims.quote: of minimal value and infrequent such that it will not cause a reasonable person to question whether it created a conflict of interest is not consideration under subsections 7112(2) and 7112(3).

Purchase confirmation for a non-strip debt security must show YTM per market conventions
claims.quote: the yield to maturity calculated in a manner consistent with market conventions for the security traded

claims.claim: Rule 4800 Part A applies to transactions not cleared and settled through a clearing corporation
claims.quote: Part A of Rule 4800 sets out additional requirements applicable to transactions that are not cleared and settled through a clearing corporation.

claims.claim: Fixed-interest securities trade on an accrued interest basis
claims.quote: All securities having interest payable as a fixed obligation, except securities in sale and repurchase agreement transactions, must be conducted on an accrued interest basis

claims.claim: Regular delivery for GoC T-bills: same day
claims.quote: The same day as the transaction date for Government of Canada Treasury Bills.

claims.claim: Regular delivery for GoC bonds with 3 years or less to maturity: first business day after the transaction date
claims.quote: The first business day after the transaction date for Government of Canada Bonds and Government of Canada Guaranteed Bonds (except Treasury Bills)

claims.claim: Regular delivery for GoC bonds longer than 3 years: first business day after the transaction date
claims.quote: The first business day after the transaction date for Government of Canada Bonds and Government of Canada Guaranteed Bonds having an unexpired term to maturity of longer than three years

claims.claim: Regular delivery for provincial bonds: first business day after; accrued interest stopped that day
claims.quote: The first business day after the transaction date for all provincial bonds or debentures. Any accrued interest must be stopped on the first business day after the transaction date.

claims.claim: Regular delivery for municipal and corporate bonds: first business day after
claims.quote: The first business day after the transaction date for all municipal, corporation and other bonds or debentures

As principal, a dealer must not buy OTC securities from / sell OTC securities to a client (subject to 3122(3))
claims.quote: to ensure fair pricing when acting as principal, a Dealer Member must not: (i) purchase over-the-counter securities for its own account from a client, or (ii) sell over- the-counter securities from its own account to a client

claims.claim: Exception: aggregate price incl. mark-up/mark-down fair and reasonable, taking into consideration all relevant factors
claims.quote: Subsection 3122(2) does not apply when a transaction is executed at an aggregate price (including any mark-up or mark-down) that is fair and reasonable, taking into consideration all relevant factors

claims.claim: As agent, commission or service charge must not exceed a fair and reasonable amount
claims.quote: To ensure fair pricing when acting as agent, a Dealer Member must not purchase over- the-counter securities, sell over-the-counter securities, or transact in over -the-counter derivatives on behalf of a client for a commission or service charge in excess of a fair and reasonable amount

claims.claim: Mark-ups reduce effective yield (buy) or net proceeds (sell)
claims.quote: since such commissions will reduce the effective yield (if buying) or the net proceeds (if selling)

claims.claim: Retail secondary-market debt confirmations: disclosure applies when not a primary market transaction and sent to a retail client
claims.quote: where the debt security trade is not a primary market transaction and the trade confirmation is being sent to a retail client

claims.claim: Option 1: total mark-up/mark-down, commission or other service charges
claims.quote: the total amount of any mark-up or mark -down, commission or other service charges the Dealer Member applied to the transaction

claims.claim: Option 2: total commission and, if a mark-up/mark-down was applied, ...
claims.quote: the total amount of any commission charged to the client by the Dealer Member and, if the Dealer Member applied a mark-up

claims.claim: ... or other non-commission service charge, the notification or a substantially similar one
claims.quote: service charge other than a commission, the following notification or a notification that is substantially similar

claims.claim: Option 2: prescribed (or substantially similar) dealer-remuneration notice - text of the notification
claims.quote: Dealer firm remuneration has been added to the price of this security (in the case of a purchase) or deducted from the price of this security (in the case of a sale).

claims.quote: interest on a compound guaranteed investment certificate (GIC) is earned monthly and automatically reinvested. The interest is paid only when the investment is cashed or matures, and not annually.

claims.claim: Interest must be reported each complete investment year
claims.quote: You must report the interest earned during each complete investment year, even if you did not receive a T5 slip.

claims.claim: Strip sold at discount to face value, matures at par
claims.quote: sold at a discount to face value and matures at par

claims.claim: No interest paid; yield compounds semi-annually and is paid at maturity
claims.quote: Strips do not pay interest, but rather, the yield at the time of purchase is compounded semi-annually and paid at maturity.

claims.claim: Created by separating a bond into interest and principal components
claims.quote: is separated into its "interest" and "principal" component parts for resale

claims.claim: Coupon = interest portion; residual = principal portion
claims.quote: The "residual": the principal portion.

claims.claim: Strip bond package = two or more components; annuity-like income possible
claims.quote: A strip bond package is a security comprised of two or more strip components. Strip bond packages can be created to provide holders with a regular income stream, similar to an annuity

claims.claim: Longer-term strip more price-volatile than shorter-term (same issuer and yield)
claims.quote: a strip with a longer term to maturity will generally be subject to greater price fluctuations than a strip of the same issuer and yield but with a shorter term to maturity

claims.claim: Per the statement, the higher strip yield reflects greater price volatility
claims.quote: the higher yield offered by strips reflects their greater price volatility

claims.claim: Strips typically yield more than conventional bonds of same issuer, term and credit rating
claims.quote: strips typically offer higher yields over T -Bills, GICs and term deposits, and over conventional bonds of the same issuer, term and credit rating

claims.claim: No dealer obligation to maintain a secondary market in strips
claims.quote: there is no requirement or obligation for investment dealers or financial institutions to maintain a secondary market for strips sold by or through them

claims.claim: CRA: strips are prescribed debt obligations
claims.quote: The Canada Revenue Agency takes the position that strip bonds are a "prescribed debt obligation" within the meaning of the Tax Act.

claims.claim: Notional interest included in income annually though none paid; strips may be more attractive in non-taxable accounts such as self-directed registered plans
claims.quote: a purchaser will be required to include in income in each year a notional amount of interest, notwithstanding that no interest will be paid or received in the year. Strips may therefore be more attractive when purchased and held in non -taxable accounts
